deleteConfirm.title: Delete this term?
deleteConfirm.text: Documents that already use it keep their copy.

footer: One default per side. Documents keep a copy of the terms they used, so changing a term never changes an issued document.

states.loadFailed: This page could not be loaded.

hints.code: Letters, digits, - and _. It cannot change later.
hints.side: Controls whether this term appears on sales documents, purchase documents, or both.
hints.dueDays: Days after the invoice date when payment is due.
hints.incoterm: Optional Incoterms 2020 code printed alongside delivery terms.
hints.nameAr: Short Arabic display name (up to 120 characters) shown in pickers and lists.
hints.nameEn: Short English display name (up to 120 characters) shown in pickers and lists.
hints.sortOrder: Whole number that sets the display order within this tab (lower appears first).
hints.textAr: Printed on Arabic documents (up to 400 characters).
hints.textEn: Printed on English documents (up to 400 characters).
hints.default: Pre-selects this term on new documents for the chosen side. Turning it on replaces the current default.
hints.defaultInactive: Turn Active on before making this term the default.
hints.defaultAlready: This term is currently the default for this side. Make another term default to change it.
hints.active: Controls whether this term can be chosen on new documents.

validation.codePattern: Start with A–Z and use 2 to 40 letters, digits, - or _.
validation.dueDaysRange: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
validation.sortOrderRange: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
